this route though, but fewer enemies and faster. }} The [[Flaming Scepter Mage]]s are an [[Ascalon|Ascalonian]] order of [[elementalists]] who specialize in [[Fire Magic]]. They are first encountered at [[Nolani Academy]], where they will help you fight [[Charr]], suggesting that they were students of the academy before the [[Searing]]. == Locations == * [[Charr Homelands]] ** {{NPC location|Dalada Uplands}} (before completing [[Forgotten Relics]]) == Missions == * [[Ascalon]] ** {{NPC location|Nolani Academy}} == Quests == '''Quests involved in:''' * [[Forgotten Relics]] == Skills == * {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}} * {{skill icon|Flare}} == Dialogue == ;Nolani Academy If the Flaming Scepter Mage is not already following: : ''"<[[Character]] name>, I'll follow you. Take me to an OBELISK."'' If the Flaming Scepter Mage is already following: : ''"I'll wait here until you're ready."'' ;Dalada Uplands : ''"People say we look alike, but spend six years as a prisoner with someone and you'll learn just how different that person can be."'' == Notes == * The [[Ascalon Prisoner|Ascalon Prisoners]] in the second half of the Nolani Academy mission also appear to be Flaming Scepter Mages and use the same dialogue if you save them. * Their armor resembles [[Elementalist Elite Luxon armor]]. * In the Dalada uplands, while their appearance is the same, each is carrying a different weapon/staff. * They also appear during the [[Ruins of Surmia]] mission, as [[Mage]].
